tess: heads-up: postmortem follow-up from the overnight ETL lag and missing spans incident. consolidating owners and next steps here.
maria: quick impact summary?
tess: 00:50-01:30 UTC we lost ~7% of spans and aggregation lagged up to 40m. cause: aggregator memory spike after an inbound shape change created large arrays in a small number of batches. autoscaler recovered but backlog caused downstream metric staleness.
alex: mitigations applied: scaled aggregator, rolled back the migration (kyle), enabled pass-through for malformed spans so dashboards could keep updating.
kyle: confirmed rollback at 01:18 UTC, captured heap profiles. root: unexpected nested field "attrs_list" causing OOM in a map-reduce step. will open schema-guard PR today.
maria: owners + estimated timelines:
- kyle: ingest schema validation + unit tests — ETA 3 business days.
- maria: targeted backfill & validation for affected window — ETA: start within 24h of deploy, ~6h runtime.
- sam: alert + runbook + synthetic CI test for malformed payloads — ETA 36h.
- tess: migration checklist + mandatory canary for schema changes — ETA 10 days.
sam: adding alert: `span_reject_rate > 2% for 15m` and dashboard card for "aggregation lag". runbook will list scale > toggle pass-through > rollback steps.
maria: backfill plan: staged reingest with compare checksums and cardinality diffs, will coordinate with analytics for validation.
kyle: fix plan: lightweight preprocessor validation, circuit-breaker on batch memory, emit `schema_reject_rate` metric. will add pre-deploy canary to CI.
tess: recurring pattern note: third schema-related ETL memory incident in ~2 months. strong recommend gating schema pushes behind a canary + migration review.
obs-bot: scheduled reminder: remediation check-in in 3 days (1792260000).
tess: action tracker (short): #1 kyle schema-guard/tests ETA 3d; #2 maria backfill/validation ETA 24-48h post-deploy; #3 sam alert/runbook/synthetic ETA 36h; #4 tess migration checklist/canary ETA 10d.
alex: please update this thread as you make progress. closing after the 3-day check-in if items are on track. :eyes:
